comment: The Client Registry is called the “single authoritative source” of health-specific identity. In federated arrangements, several legally authoritative source systems may contribute to a governed national identity-resolution capability.

public.text: The Client Registry is called the “single authoritative source” of health-specific identity. In federated arrangements, several legally authoritative source systems may contribute to a governed national identity-resolution capability.
public.suggestedRevision: Replace with authoritative national health-identity reference capability and clarify that it may be centralised, federated, or hybrid, with clearly assigned authority and reconciliation rules.
